g.text: Each tile is one row of the expected-outcome matrix (spec 5.2) for one system. Flag is the share of cases put in front of a reviewer: a rule fired, no explanation was found, or

text.style: font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #8a8a8a

g.text: the model answered verify or escalate. Esc is the share the model escalated to the Privacy Officer. Darker tiles flag more. The mark comes from the coded rule of spec 11.5:

text.style: font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #8a8a8a

g.text: held when 90% or more of the cases match the prediction, partly at 50-89%, contradicted below. No test marks a prediction that any answer would meet. Misuse is above the

text.style: font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #8a8a8a

g.text: line, legitimate work below it. Same scores as docs/llm-results.md.
